description: Bluesky Frame Rate Converter (FRC) - GPU-accelerated frame rate conversion for real-time video playback, installed as DirectShow filters.
notes: This package is a DirectShow filter pair (BlueskyFRC32.dll / BlueskyFRC64.dll), not a standalone application. After installing, run BlueskyFRCUtil.exe once as administrator to register the filters, then use them from a DirectShow-capable media player.

The official server serves the ZIP only to a request whose Referer is the product page's bfrc/download/?vs=...&tp=p&hs=... URL; a plain request returns 404. To install, configure Scoop's private_hosts for bluesky-soft.com (match the download URL, set the Referer header to that URL) and run 'scoop config aria2-enabled false' so the built-in downloader is used. See the bluesky-frc receipt in docs/plans/active/add-bluesky-frc/ for the exact configuration.
Upstream lists Microsoft .NET Framework 4.8.1 and Visual C++ runtimes (x86/x64) as runtime requirements.
